verified: Optional public Protocol fails closed without support; all new concrete graph queries and mutations live in Community Grafx.
The replacement association must exist before removing the exact old Learning-to-Bug pair. Complete before-image comparison refuses source-edge drift or disappearance of the replacement.
Other Bug origins and nodes remain unchanged. No global superseded_by mark or relational active-set ownership is used.
Disposable Grafx tests prove rollback and exact multiset restoration, including identical parallel edges, differing properties, idempotency and compensation in a new transaction after commit.
The orchestrator records the receipt before mutation, restores it before session cleanup, and preserves the affected historical before-image even if stamped with that session ID.
An injected post-DELETE failure discards staged graph effects. Restoration refuses a concurrent property change instead of overwriting it.
Paired wheels were installed and verified byte-for-byte before behavior tests. Final F16 has all eight budgets at zero and no documentation drift.
limits: Capability is not yet wired into the authored supersedence materializer. Semantic source/capture qualification, joint source CAS, audit/outbox, recovery and scoped query/rebuild remain integration work.
The new graph tests use a small disposable physical schema. Existing Grafx provider and authored reuse regressions accompany them; this is not a full installed release or full lifecycle campaign.

Initial Community failure is preserved: fixture stamped unrelated origins with the current session ID, so existing session-owned cleanup removed them. Corrected fixture uses prior-session ownership for unrelated origins, while retaining same-session affected before-images. Production begin_consolidation mints a new UUID session ID.
No claim is made that arbitrary reuse of a session ID preserves unrelated edges owned by that session; the existing generic compensation ownership contract is unchanged.
No public tools, REST/UI, frontend, schema version, real data, release or deployment changed. Overall F6/K3/K4 and plan acceptance remain incomplete.
